Chapter 6026: Leave This To Me

Chapter 6026: Leave This To Me

“What?!” Greatsword, Smoke Fiend, and others stood there in a daze.

They prepared for death after activating the oblivion domain. Rapid aging would have been their outcome.

No one could save them, not even Splendor Monarch. Therefore, how did someone save them from a certain demise?

“It’s time!” Omni shouted once the domain dispersed, leaping for the main palace. His goal was the horn of the unicorn.

“They’re mine!” Allmountain was considerably stronger so with just one step, he caused time to freeze and sped past Omni.

He wanted all six treasures and activated his power: “Myriad Mountains As One!”

“Boom!” A mountainous domain appeared behind him and continued to spread, wanting to engulf the whole region. A primal power descended to take in the palaces and the sky above them.

“Activate!” Omni and the others couldn’t just watch Allmountain take everything despite being outmatched.

Omni summoned his seal, sending it straight at the unicorn’s horn to knock it away.

“When the fiends walk, all will return to nothing!” Buddha Fiend roared and summoned a world of countless specters and Buddhists. They rushed forward, intending to take any of the six treasures.

“Get down!” Li Qiye looked annoyed and raised his hand, uttering coldly.

The gauntlet erupted brightly with the power of endless time containing various affinities including karma, reincarnation…

“Damn!” Allmountain’s expression soured after seeing the torrential power: “Myriad Mountain Border!”

He abandoned his attempt to suck everything into his domain and channeled his power defensively instead.

Omni and the others also shifted their priorities. After all, life was more important than treasures.

They roared and activated their defensive dao to stop the incoming attack.

“Omni Corner!” Omni gathered power from everything around him, creating a layer of fortification.

“Unbreakable Fiends!” Buddha Fiend commanded and the legion of specters returned, forming a wall in front of him.

“Boom!” All three defenses failed to stop the temporal power so they were blasted into the ground.

Fortunately for Omni and Buddha Fiend, Allmountain had borne the brunt of the attack. Otherwise, they would have been reduced to blood.

Nevertheless, all three vomited blood. The pale Allmountain gazed at the gauntlet and said: “What a masterpiece, the gauntlet is unstoppable with those six gems.”

Other treasures required a capable cultivator to activate them. However, Splendor Monarch had enough money to acquire six precious gems as the powering sources, making it simple to use the gauntlet.

Strangely enough, Li Qiye had no interest and tossed it away, disappearing into the depths of the main palace.

This astounded the attackers so they rubbed their eyes in confusion. Not to mention a mortal, even someone such as Allmountain coveted the six treasures.

Now, he tossed the gauntlet away as if it was a piece of trash. This defied logic and reason.

***

Li Qiye entered the boundless dimension within the main palace. This was not his first time here.

He saw Unrivalled Monarch struggling against an endless power.

“Leave this to me, go.” He said while looking forward.

“Young Noble.” When she saw him, she had an expression that couldn’t be described with words.

Just like her title, she was both gorgeous and elegant, surpassing all others in the realm. She was blessed with a lithe and curvaceous figure. Her eyes displayed nobility and authority.

The two had met previously back in the bamboo hut outside of Splendor City.

In this split second, she decisively made a choice and left the dimension.

***

With Li Qiye gone, Allmountain and the other regained their wits, once again soaring for the six treasures.

“Clank!” They were greeted by the glint of a spear thrust, forcing them to assume a defensive stance again.
